caption: The drawing depicts a metal andiron with a rounded, ornamented vertical post and a curved horizontal support that leads to three scroll-shaped feet resting on spherical bases. The post and feet feature repeated bands and carved details. The primary rendering is in color, using shades of yellow and green to mimic the reflective quality of polished brass or bronze, with darker tones for shadows. To the left of the main object is a smaller, monochrome technical side-view of the same andiron, including a scale marked in inches. The drawing is enclosed within a simple lined border, and the name “Hans Korsch” is written in the bottom right corner. The background is a plain off-white color, and the objects have faint shadows for depth.
title: Andiron
